_comment: Rolling metric baselines for the golden set. The ACR-regression hard gate (CLAUDE.md §5) fails the build if measured ACR falls more than acr_regression_delta below baseline_acr. Other metrics are tracked/trended, not gated. Update deliberately when the golden set or the model/harness baseline legitimately moves; record why in notes.
notes: Initial baseline from the frozen 2-fixture golden set (REQ-SERVE-001, REQ-RTMX-003), both autonomously closed. ACR=1.0; gate allows a 0.05 drop before failing.
